All objectives verified. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE.** The provisioned dashboard `Service health` (shown in the UI as "Service Health") has 3 panels, titles exactly as shown: **"Request rate"**, **"Error count"**, **"Latency by endpoint"**.

**Objective 2 — DONE.** New dashboard titled **"fwgr66-n1 Bench Dashboard"** exists and is saved. It contains a **Stat** panel titled **"fwgr66-n1 Availability"** whose query uses the **TestData** data source (query row reads "A (TestData)", scenario "Random Walk"; the panel rendered a live value, e.g. -0.418 on the final reload). Verified persisting after a fresh page load.

**Objective 3 — DONE.** The same dashboard contains a **Text** panel titled **"fwgr66-n1 Notes"** with content **"Notes for run fwgr66-n1"** (includes the runid). Save confirmed with the on-screen "Dashboard saved" alert, and the panel text re-read from the live DOM after reload.

**Objective 4 — DONE.** Dashboard settings > General > Tags shows the chip **"bench"**, and the top-bar time picker reads **"Last 6 hours"** (URL params `from=now-6h&to=now`). Persistence was ensured by ticking the save dialog's **"Update default time range"** checkbox (verified `input#save-timerange` checked=true) before saving; save confirmed with "Dashboard saved".

**Objective 5 — DONE.** The auto-refresh interval is **"1m"** (refresh control aria-label: "Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected"). Persistence was ensured by ticking the save dialog's **"Update default refresh value"** checkbox before saving; save confirmed with "Dashboard saved".

**Objective 6 — DONE.** URL read from the browser's address bar on a fresh load:
`http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/cfz0catayheyob/fwgr66-n1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m`
Dashboard UID: **cfz0catayheyob**. The URL params (`from=now-6h&to=now&refresh=1m`) are consistent with the persisted defaults.

Final state check on a fresh reload: title "fwgr66-n1 Bench Dashboard", 2 panels ("fwgr66-n1 Notes", "fwgr66-n1 Availability"), time range "Last 6 hours", refresh "1m", tag "bench" — all persisted.
